train_legacy_masked_language_model: train a legacy masked language model using cross_lingual_lm task with specified architecture and extra args
train_masked_lm: train a masked language model with the specified architecture using adam optimizer and masked_lm criterion
train_roberta_head: train a RoBERTa sentence prediction head for classification or regression with the given number of classes
eval_lm_main: evaluate a trained language model checkpoint on data and compute perplexity metrics
create_dummy_roberta_head_data: create dummy training validation and test data for RoBERTa sentence prediction or regression tasks
